entries.title: DNS
entries.text:
/api/dns
requireHostingAccess on every route. Manages BIND-backed DNS zones and records, plus optional DNS Cluster replication and master/slave conversion.
Zones
Method & PathDescription
GET /zones
List all zones.
GET /zones/:domainName
Zone + all its records.
POST /zones
Body: domainName (required), clientName?, serverType? (default bind). Creates the zone, writes it to BIND, fire-and-forget pushes to any DNS Cluster peers.
DELETE /zones/:domainName
Removes all records + the zone row, deletes the BIND zone file/named.conf entry, fire-and-forget propagates the deletion to cluster peers.
PUT /zones/:domainName/enable
Enables DNS serving for the zone.
PUT /zones/:domainName/disable
Disables it.
POST /zones/:domainName/rebuild
Body: ipAddress (required). Rebuilds the zone from its template.
POST /zones/:domainName/reset
Body: ipAddress (required). Resets the zone to the default template.
GET /zones/:domainName/validate
Checks zone-file syntax.
POST /zones/:domainName/sync-slaves
Pushes to DNS Cluster peers (stamps clusterSyncedAt) and, if configured, also triggers legacy secondaryNs sync.
POST /zones/push-all-to-cluster
Pushes every master zone that's missing from any configured cluster member. Response: {success, pushed, message}.
POST /zones/:domainName/promote-to-master
Converts a slave zone to master on this server.
POST /zones/:domainName/convert-to-slave
Body: masterIp (required). Converts a master zone to a slave that AXFR-syncs from masterIp. Not pushed to the cluster — a slave has nothing authoritative to replicate.
Records
Method & PathDescription
POST /zones/:domainName/records
Body: recordType, hostname, content (required), ttl? (default 3600), priority?/weight?/port? (default 0). Fire-and-forget cluster push.
PUT /zones/:domainName/records/:recordId
recordId is the record's nname. Fire-and-forget cluster push.
DELETE /zones/:domainName/records/:recordId
Removes the record, bumps the zone serial, resyncs, fire-and-forget cluster push.
POST /zones/:domainName/records/:recordId/clone
Body: newHostname (required). Duplicates a record under a new hostname.
Auto-generation helpers
Method & PathBodyDescription
POST /zones/:domainName/auto-spf
mailServers?
Generates an SPF TXT record.
POST /zones/:domainName/auto-dmarc
policy? (none|quarantine|reject, default quarantine), pct? (1–100), ruaEmail?, rufEmail?
Generates a DMARC TXT record.
POST /zones/:domainName/auto-dkim
selector? (default default)
Creates a DKIM record placeholder — the actual keypair is generated by the Mail DKIM endpoint, not here.
POST /zones/:domainName/auto-mx
mailServer (required), priority? (default 10)
Generates an MX record.
POST /zones/:domainName/auto-a-records
ipAddress (required)
Generates A records for common subdomains (www, mail, ftp, etc.).
PUT /zones/:domainName/update-ip
newIp (required)
Bulk-updates every A record in the zone to a new IP in one call.
Templates
Method & PathDescription
GET /templates
Query: clientName?. Lists built-in (default, minimal, email-centric) plus custom templates.
POST /templates
Body: templateName, records (required), clientName?.
PUT /templates/:templateName
Built-ins are protected (403).
DELETE /templates/:templateName
Built-ins are protected (403).
Service control & server switch
Method & PathDescription
GET /status
Active DNS driver, whether BIND/named is running, zone/record counts.
POST /restart
Restarts the DNS service.
POST /reload
Re-renders every zone's config on disk.
POST /fix-dns
Body: domainName?, sync?. Bumps serial(s) and re-syncs one zone or all zones; restarts the service if sync is true.
POST /switch-server
Body: serverType. Switches the server-wide DNS backend driver (e.g. BIND → PowerDNS).

entries.title: DNS Zone Import
entries.text:
/api/dns-import
requireAdmin migration (Pro) on every route. SSHes into a remote Linux DNS server, discovers its BIND zones, and imports selected ones locally as additional authoritative/backup nameserver copies (starting as master, convertible to slave via the DNS module above).
Method & PathBodyDescription
POST /test
host, sshPassword (required), sshUser? (default root), sshPort? (default 22)
Verifies SSH connectivity and BIND presence.
POST /discover
same connection fields
Parses the remote named.conf family to enumerate zones (excluding built-in BIND system zones), flagging which already exist locally.
POST /import
connection fields + zones (array, required, non-empty)
For each selected zone not already present locally: fetches and parses the remote zone file over SSH, creates a local master zone + records, syncs, fire-and-forget pushes to the cluster. Per-zone success/failure is reported in the response array rather than failing the whole request.
Example
curl -X POST https://<your-server>:7777/api/dns-import/discover \
-H "Authorization: Bearer <TOKEN>" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
-d '{"host":"203.0.113.10","sshUser":"root","sshPassword":"…"}'

entries.title: Mail
entries.text:
/api/mail
requireHostingAccess on every route. Backed by qmail + vpopmail; falls back gracefully (DB-only) if vpopmail sync fails on any individual call.
The source tree also contains an older mail.ts file defining a similar-looking route set — it is never mounted (api.ts only wires up mail2.ts at this prefix) and can be ignored entirely; it's included here only so you don't confuse it with the live implementation below.
Server status & control
Method & PathDescription
GET /server/status
qmail/vpopmail install state + live status of SMTP/send/Dovecot/SpamAssassin/ClamAV.
POST /server/start|stop|restart
Body: service (required). Controls a named mail service (daemontools-aware for qmail).
POST /server/install
Installs the full qmail-toaster stack.
GET / PUT /server/config
Reads/writes a qmail control-file setting. PUT body: key (required), value.
Queue
Method & PathDescription
GET /queue
Totals + up to 100 enriched messages (size/subject).
POST /queue/flush
Forces immediate delivery attempts across the whole queue.
GET /queue/:id/content
id must be numeric. Raw message body.
POST /queue/:id/retry
Wakes qmail-send — affects all deferred mail, not just this message, despite the per-id path.
DELETE /queue/:id
Deletes one queued message.
Domains
Method & PathDescription
GET /domains
Both the panel's DB list and vpopmail's live domain list, for cross-checking.
GET /domains/:domainName
Rich view: domain + accounts + catchall + forwards + mailing lists + DKIM status, in one call.
POST /domains
Body: domainName (required), clientName?, password? (postmaster, default postmaster), catchallEmail?, spamFilter? (default true), virusScan? (default false). 409 if it already exists.
DELETE /domains/:domainName
Cascades to all accounts/forwards/mailing lists, then best-effort removes the vpopmail domain.
POST /domains/:domainName/toggle
Body: enable. Enables/disables the mail domain.
Accounts
Method & PathDescription
GET /accounts
Query: domainName?, clientName?.
POST /accounts
Body: username, domainName, password (required), quota? (MB, default 100), smtpAccess?/imapAccess?/pop3Access? (default true), webmailAccess? (default false), clientName?. 409 if the account exists.
POST /accounts/import-from-vpopmail
Body: domainName (required). Reverse-syncs from vpopmail's flat-file vpasswd, falling back to a direct MySQL query if the file backend is empty (supports both vpopmail storage modes). Imported accounts get a blank password.
DELETE /accounts/:email
Deletes the DB row + best-effort removes from vpopmail.
POST /accounts/:email/change-password
Body: password (required).
POST /accounts/:email/quota
Body: quota.
POST /accounts/:email/toggle
Body: enable.
Catch-all, forwarding, autoresponder, mailing lists
Method & PathDescription
GET / POST /domains/:domainName/catchall DELETE
Get/set/clear the domain's catch-all address (live vpopmail read/write, mirrored into the DB).
GET /domains/:domainName/forwards
Lists live forwards.
POST /forwards
Body: email, destination (required), keepCopy? (default true).
DELETE /forwards/:email
Removes a forward.
GET / POST /accounts/:email/autoresponder
Get/set the vacation-responder message + enabled flag.
GET /domains/:domainName/mailing-lists
List ezmlm-style lists.
POST /domains/:domainName/mailing-lists
Body: listName (required), adminEmail?.
DELETE /domains/:domainName/mailing-lists/:listName
Removes a list.
DKIM
Method & PathDescription
POST /domains/:domainName/dkim/generate
Generates a 1024-bit RSA keypair and writes the public key as a DNS TXT record in the panel's own DNS zone for the domain (removing any pre-existing one first).
GET /domains/:domainName/dkim
Reads current DKIM status; self-heals by recreating the DNS TXT record if a key exists but the record went missing.
POST /domains/:domainName/dkim/sync-dns
Despite the name, this only confirms DKIM is set up (400 if not) — it does not itself resync the DNS record; that self-healing happens inside the GET above.
POST /dkim/toggle
Body: enable. Server-wide DKIM signing toggle (distinct from per-domain generation above).
Anti-spam / anti-virus
Method & PathDescription
GET /spam/config
Reads SpamAssassin's local.cf (enabled, global score, rewrite-subject).
POST /spam/score
Body: score (required). Rewrites required_score and restarts SpamAssassin.
POST /spam/blacklist
Body: entries (array, required). Replaces the server-wide sender blacklist.
POST /spam/whitelist
Body: entries (array, required). Same for the whitelist.
GET /clamav/config
Whether the mail-pipeline ClamAV scanner is active.
POST /virus-scan/toggle
Body: enable. Server-wide ClamAV toggle in the mail pipeline.
Spamdyke (SMTP-time gateway)
Method & PathDescription
GET /spamdyke/config
Full parsed config: greet delay, max recipients, greylisting, rDNS checks, RBL servers, DKIM/virus-scan integration.
PUT /spamdyke/config
Body: the full settings object. Rewrites the config file.
POST /spamdyke/install
Installs spamdyke and wires it into qmail's SMTP invocation.
POST /spamdyke/toggle
Body: enable.
Logs & webmail status
Method & PathDescription
GET /logs/:type
type: smtp|send (mapped internally). Query lines? (default 50).
GET /webmail/status
Filesystem-detected install state + URL for Roundcube/RainLoop/SquirrelMail.
Example: create a mailbox
curl -X POST https://<your-server>:7777/api/mail/accounts \
-H "Authorization: Bearer <TOKEN>" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
-d '{"username":"sales","domainName":"example.com","password":"S3cure!Pass","quota":250}'

entries.title: Databases
entries.text:
/api/databases
requireHostingAccess on every route.
Method & PathDescription
GET /
Query: clientName?. Lists databases.
POST /
Body: dbName (required), clientName? (default admin), charset? (default utf8mb4), collation?. Creates the record and the real MySQL database.
DELETE /:dbName
Removes the panel record only — does not drop the MySQL database. See Known Limitations.
GET /users
Query: clientName?. Lists DB users (password stripped).
POST /users
Body: dbUserName, password (required), host? (default localhost), clientName?. Creates the record and the real MySQL user.
POST /users/:username/grant
Body: dbName, privileges. Grants MySQL privileges. There is no DELETE for a DB user in this file — not exposed via this API surface.
Example
curl -X POST https://<your-server>:7777/api/databases \
-H "Authorization: Bearer <TOKEN>" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
-d '{"dbName":"shop_orders","clientName":"acme_corp"}'

entries.title: FTP
entries.text:
/api/ftp
requireHostingAccess on every route.
Method & PathDescription
GET /
Query: domainName?, clientName?. Lists FTP users (password stripped).
POST /
Body: username, password (required), domainName?, homedir?, quota? (default 0), clientName?. clientName/homedir auto-resolved from the domain if not given.
DELETE /:username
Removes the panel record only — same "DB-only delete" caveat as Databases above.
POST /:username/change-password
Body: password.

entries.title: SSL Certificates
entries.text:
/api/ssl
No authorization middleware at all on this router — any authenticated user can install a certificate for any domain name string, with no ownership check. See Known Limitations.
Method & PathDescription
GET /
Lists certificates (private key stripped, daysRemaining computed).
GET /:domainName
Single certificate lookup.
POST /
Body: domainName (required), certType? (selfsigned triggers the self-signed branch; otherwise commercial, requiring certificate+privateKey). The self-signed branch does not sync to any web server — it only saves the cert to disk/DB. The commercial branch does sync.
DELETE /:domainName
Removes the panel record only — no on-disk cleanup, no vhost SSL config change.
POST /self-signed
Body: domainName. A near-duplicate of the self-signed branch of POST / above — redundant, kept for backward compatibility.

entries.title: Let's Encrypt
entries.text:
/api/letsencrypt
Reads (GET /certificates, GET /status) require no more than a session; every mutating route below is individually requireAdmin.
Method & PathDescription
GET /certificates
Lists certificates: domainName, validTo, issuer, autoRenew.
GET /status
Whether acme.sh is installed.
POST /install
Installs acme.sh.
POST /issue
Body: domainName (required), email?, keyBits?, additionalDomains? (string array). Auto-detects existing subdomains from the domain's own DNS zone and merges them into one combined SAN request; installs the cert into the active web server and sets up auto-renewal.
POST /renew
Body: domainName (required).
POST /revoke
Body: domainName (required).
web.ts's POST /:domainName/ssl/letsencrypt//ssl/renew are thin, domain-scoped wrappers around this exact same service — but sit behind requireHostingAccess only, not requireAdmin. Two paths to the same action, different authorization requirements.
Example: issue a certificate
curl -X POST https://<your-server>:7777/api/letsencrypt/issue \
-H "Authorization: Bearer <TOKEN>" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
-d '{"domainName":"example.com","email":"admin@example.com"}'

entries.title: System
entries.text:
/api/system
The largest single module — server metrics, service control, cron, self-update, and more. Auth varies per route; most read-only metrics endpoints require no more than a session, while anything that changes server state is requireAdmin. See the per-table notes.
Background task polling
Method & PathAuthDescription
GET /tasks
session
Query: type?, status?. Lists in-memory background tasks (backups, restores, migrations, self-update...). Not persisted — a panel restart clears the list.
GET /tasks/:id
session
The canonical polling endpoint referenced throughout this reference — see Conventions.
DELETE /tasks/:id
admin
Soft-deletes a task; refuses (400) while it's still running.
POST /tasks/cleanup
admin
Prunes old completed/failed tasks.
System info & metrics
Method & PathDescription
GET /info
OS-level snapshot (hostname, uptime, platform, CPU/memory counts, network interfaces).
GET /sysinfo
Richer dashboard payload — OS name, kernel, CPU model, formatted memory/swap/disk usage with percentages.
GET /cpu-sample
Instantaneous CPU% via two /proc/stat reads 250ms apart — intended to be polled for a live graph.
GET /disk
Parsed df -h output.
GET /memory
Parsed free -m output.
GET /processes
Top 20 processes by memory (ps aux --sort=-%mem). Not admin-gated — any logged-in user can see the full process list, including other users' running commands.
GET /version
Just { version }.
Services & drivers
Method & PathAuthDescription
GET /services
session
Install/running status of every registered service driver.
POST /services/restart
admin
Body: serviceType, driverName.
POST /services/switch
admin
Body: serviceType, driverName. Changes the default driver implementation for a service type; does not migrate data itself.
GET /drivers
session
Lists all registered driver definitions.
Settings, hostname, and web server backend
Method & PathAuthDescription
GET /settings
session
Returns the entire GlobalState settings blob, unredacted.
PUT /settings
admin
Merges the whole body into settings — no whitelist/schema.
POST /hostname
admin
Body: hostname (required, FQDN). Changes the OS hostname, qmail's identity files, restarts mail services. Does not touch DNS A/PTR records — you must update those with your upstream provider separately.
POST /webserver
admin
Body: target (apache|nginx). Full backend cutover: installs the target if needed, migrates every domain's vhost + SSL + webmail vhost, restarts. Non-fatal per-domain errors are collected in the response rather than aborting.
Fix scripts
requireAdmin. POST /fix-script, body { script }. Each name below performs a real corrective action:
fixweb
Rebuild every vhost + restart web server.
fixdns
Rebuild every zone file + restart DNS server.
fixmail
Re-sync every mail domain into qmail/vpopmail + restart.
fixftp
Restart the FTP server (no rebuild needed — MySQL-backed auth).
fixssl
Rebuild the SSL vhost block for every domain with a cert.
fixphpini
Rebuild every PHP-FPM pool config.
fixchownchmod
Fix ownership/permissions across every client's domains.
fixservice
Restart any managed service that's currently down.
restart-all
Restart every managed service.
fix-mail-database
Repair vpopmail/panel MySQL users, grants, and auth config.
fix-firewall
Reopen every port SysAdminHCP needs.
fix-acme-challenge
Recreate the Let's Encrypt HTTP-01 challenge directory + Apache alias.
fix-webmail
Recreate webmail PHP-FPM pool(s) + every domain's webmail vhost.
fix-selinux-apparmor
Reapply SELinux booleans (RHEL) or the AppArmor override (Ubuntu).
Logs
GET /logs/:type — session only (not admin-gated, including the secure auth log). Query lines? (default 50). Valid type values: sysadminhcp, sysadminhcp_error, sysadminhcp_update, httpd/apache, nginx, mail, qmail, mysql, system, secure, ftp.
Backup / restore (legacy — see also Backups)
requireAdmin. This is a separate, simpler implementation from the primary /api/backups module — synchronous (blocks the request up to 10 minutes), stores to /backup/sysadminhcp rather than /var/backup/sysadminhcp, and has no upload/retrieve/schedule support. The dedicated /api/backups module is what the UI actually uses.
Method & PathBodyDescription
POST /backup
type, target, destination, includeMail
type='full': all-databases dump + panel data + /home + /opt/configs (+ mailnames if includeMail). 'domain'/'client': narrower tar of just that target.
POST /restore
file, type
Extracts and restores from a prior backup of this format.
Firewall (embedded copy)
This is one of three independent firewall surfaces in the API — see Known Limitations before relying on any single one as the source of truth.
Method & PathAuthDescription
GET /firewall/status
session
{ firewalld, csfInstalled, status }.
POST /firewall/block
admin
Body: ip, reason. Prefers CSF, falls back to firewalld; DB-tracked via a BlockedIp row.
POST /firewall/unblock
admin
Body: ip.
POST /firewall/allow
admin
Body: ip, description.
POST /firewall/disallow
admin
Body: ip.
GET /firewall/blocked
session
Returns the DB-tracked list — not the live firewall ruleset.
GET /firewall/allowed
session
Same, for allowed IPs.
Resource Plans (duplicate surface)
requireAdmin on mutations, session-only on GET. Same underlying table as the dedicated Resource Plans module, but this version accepts arbitrary body fields with no whitelist (repo.create(req.body)/Object.assign) — prefer the dedicated module unless you specifically need that.
GET /resource-plans
POST /resource-plans
PUT /resource-plans/:name
DELETE /resource-plans/:name
Cron
Method & PathAuthDescription
GET /cron
session
Merges 3 sources: the panel service account's own crontab (editable), /etc/cron.d/* (read-only), and /etc/cron.{hourly,daily,weekly,monthly}/* (read-only).
POST /cron
admin
Body: schedule, command, comment. Appends to the user crontab.
PUT /cron/:id
admin
id is a positional index into the crontab at read time — not stable if the crontab changes between your GET and this call.
DELETE /cron/:id
admin
Same positional-index caveat.
POST /cron/install-required
admin
Installs any missing panel-required cron jobs (idempotent).
IP address management & Switch Host IP
Method & PathAuthDescription
GET /ipaddresses
session
OS network interfaces merged with saved per-IP mode config.
POST /ipaddresses/reread
admin
Re-scans OS interfaces.
PUT /ipaddresses/:ip/config
admin
Body: mode (shared|dedicated), domain.
GET /switch-ip/preview
admin
Query: oldIp (required). Read-only blast-radius report before committing a real switch — DNS record count, Web row count, whether an IP-mode entry exists.
POST /switch-ip
admin
Body: oldIp, newIp (required). Bulk data-level rewrite: every matching DNS A record, zone resync + reload, fire-and-forget cluster push, Web.ipaddress, re-keyed IP-mode map, best-effort license revalidation. Does not touch the OS network interface — that's a manual step you still need to do.
Example: preview then commit an IP switch
curl "https://<your-server>:7777/api/system/switch-ip/preview?oldIp=203.0.113.10" \
-H "Authorization: Bearer <TOKEN>"
curl -X POST https://<your-server>:7777/api/system/switch-ip \
-H "Authorization: Bearer <TOKEN>" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
-d '{"oldIp":"203.0.113.10","newIp":"203.0.113.20"}'
MySQL root password
Method & PathDescription
GET /mysql/password
admin. Only reports whether a password is saved — never the value.
POST /mysql/password
admin. Body: currentPassword?, newPassword (≥6 chars). Verifies the current password before changing it.
Revision & deploy history
Method & PathDescription
GET /revision
Currently-installed version + deploy metadata. managed:false on a dev-mode install with no revision file.
GET /deploy-history
Array of past deployments (only populated on installs actually managed via the release pipeline).
Self-update
Method & PathAuthDescription
GET /update-check
session
Compares the installed version against GitHub's published VERSION file. Prefers a same-day cached result over a live fetch. selfUpdateAvailable reflects whether this install is a compiled binary (as opposed to a dev-mode source checkout).
POST /self-update
admin
Only works on compiled-binary installs (400 otherwise). Runs the official installer script as root inside a dedicated systemd-run unit so it survives the panel's own restart partway through. Fire-and-forget — a successful response means the update started, not that it finished. Progress logs to /var/log/sysadminhcp/self-update.log.
GET /update-check/schedule
admin
Whether the opt-in daily update-check cron is installed.
POST /update-check/schedule
admin
Body: enabled. Installs/removes the daily cron — verification only, it never auto-installs an update itself.
Example: trigger a self-update
curl -X POST https://<your-server>:7777/api/system/self-update \
-H "Authorization: Bearer <TOKEN>"
# { "started": true, "logFile": "/var/log/sysadminhcp/self-update.log", "unitName": "sysadminhcp-selfupdate-…" }

entries.title: Security
entries.text:
/api/security
requireAdmin on the entire router — the most consistently gated of the security-adjacent modules.
SSH config
Method & PathDescription
GET /ssh/config
Parsed effective config: port, permitRootLogin, passwordAuthentication, pubkeyAuthentication, maxAuthTries, allowUsers, denyUsers, clientAliveInterval, clientAliveCountMax.
PUT /ssh/config
Body: any subset of the above. Writes only to a dedicated override file (never the package-managed main config), validates with sshd -t before applying, and auto-reverts on validation failure. Reloads sshd on success — existing sessions aren't dropped, but a bad port value means you lose SSH access on the next connection attempt even though validation passed syntax-check.
POST /ssh/restart
Hard restart (not reload) — briefly drops existing connections.
ClamAV
Method & PathDescription
GET /clamav/status
Install/active state, version, signature age, and current scan status.
POST /clamav/install
Installs ClamAV + enables signature auto-update.
POST /clamav/update
Runs freshclam.
POST /clamav/scan
Body: path? (default /home, validated against a safe-character regex). Fire-and-forget async scan; refuses if one is already running.
GET /clamav/scan/result
Poll for the running/most recent scan's result.
Fail2ban
Method & PathDescription
GET /fail2ban/status
Install state + jail count + total-banned count.
POST /fail2ban/install
Installs and starts the service.
GET /fail2ban/jails
Per-jail detail including currently-banned IP list.
POST /fail2ban/unban
Body: jail, ip.
POST /fail2ban/restart
Blocked / whitelisted IPs (firewalld zones only)
No CSF awareness at all here — on a CSF-managed box these silently do nothing useful. Also note ip is interpolated into the firewalld command with no format validation.
GET /blocked-ips
POST /blocked-ips
DELETE /blocked-ips/:ip
GET /whitelist
POST /whitelist
DELETE /whitelist/:ip

entries.title: Firewall
entries.text:
/api/firewall
No requireAdmin anywhere in this file. Any authenticated user — including the lowest-privilege customer login — can add/remove firewall rules, block/allow arbitrary IPs, and restart the firewall. See Known Limitations for the command-injection concern in the same routes.
Method & PathBodyDescription
GET /rules
—
Parses firewall-cmd --list-all (or falls back to iptables -L) into rule objects.
POST /rules
port (required), protocol? (default tcp), source?, action? (allow/other)
Adds or removes a port rule.
DELETE /rules/:id
—
Parses id's port-/svc- prefix to know what to remove.
POST /blocked
ip (required)
Drop-zone block.
POST /allowed
ip (required)
Trusted-zone allow.
POST /restart
—
Reloads the firewall.

entries.title: Backups
entries.text:
/api/backups
No requireAdmin anywhere — every route, including full-system restore, is reachable by any authenticated user. The SysAdminHCP-format restore path extracts an uploaded/retrieved archive directly onto / as root; treat this entire module as admin-only in front of whatever authorization layer you add.
List / create / delete
Method & PathDescription
GET /
Lists backup archives, auto-detecting format (KloxoNG / cPanel / SysAdminHCP) per file.
POST /
Body: backupType? (default full), target?, destination? (local or remote), includeMail?, plus remote-destination fields (destHost, destPort, destUser, destPass, destPath). Async, task-tracked; uploads to the remote destination after the local tar completes if requested.
DELETE /:name
name is not sanitized against path traversal here the way fileManager.ts sanitizes its inputs.
Restore (auto-detects format)
POST /:name/restore — dispatches to a KloxoNG-specific, cPanel-specific, or SysAdminHCP-format restore based on file detection. All three are async/task-tracked. The SysAdminHCP-format branch restarts the panel itself at the end via a detached setsid shell so the restart doesn't kill the restore script mid-flight.
Schedule
GET /schedule
PUT /schedule
Body: frequency (daily|weekly|monthly), time (HH:MM), retention (days).
Upload / retrieve
Method & PathDescription
POST /upload
Multipart field backup.
POST /retrieve
Body: source (sftp|ftp), host, port, user, pass, path?, filename (required). Pulls a remote backup down onto the server.
Format-specific helpers
Method & PathDescription
GET /:name/format
Detected format + compatibility flag.
GET /:name/contents
KloxoNG-format only — lists the archive's account contents without restoring.
POST /:name/restore-kloxong
Full option control (accounts, skipExisting, restoreDns/Mail/Databases/Ssl/Ftp).
POST /upload-kloxong
Multipart field backup.
POST /upload-cpanel
Multipart field backup (a cPanel pkgacct archive).
GET /:name/analyze-cpanel
Account/DB/email/DNS summary without restoring.
POST /:name/restore-cpanel
Body: restoreDns/Mail/Databases/Files, skipExisting.
Example: create a full backup and poll it
curl -X POST https://<your-server>:7777/api/backups \
-H "Authorization: Bearer <TOKEN>" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
-d '{"backupType":"full","includeMail":true}'
# { "success": true, "filename": "...", "taskId": "..." }
curl https://<your-server>:7777/api/system/tasks/<taskId> \
-H "Authorization: Bearer <TOKEN>"

entries.title: File Manager
entries.text:
/api/files
No requireAdmin anywhere — scoping is enforced internally instead. Admin/sysadminhcp users can reach /home, /var/www, the panel's own httpdocs, /opt/configs, panel logs, and /tmp. Every other user is hard-confined to their own /home/<username> tree regardless of path given. Path traversal (.. anywhere in the resolved path) is explicitly rejected.
Method & PathParams/BodyDescription
GET /list
query path?, showHidden?
Directory listing with type/size/perms/owner/mtime.
GET /file
query path (required)
Reads a file's content + MIME type.
PUT /file
path, content
Overwrites file content.
POST /mkdir
path, name
Creates a directory.
POST /touch
path, name, content?
Creates a new file.
DELETE /
query path (required)
Deletes one file/dir.
POST /delete-bulk
paths[]
Best-effort per-path; reports successes/errors separately.
POST /rename
path, newName
POST /move
paths[], destDir
POST /copy
paths[], destDir
POST /chmod
path, permissions, recursive?
Explicitly documented as available to any user, scoped to their own home.
POST /compress
paths[], parentDir, name, format? (targz or zip)
POST /extract
path, destDir
POST /upload
multipart files[] (up to 50, 200MB each), field destDir
Per-file failures don't abort the batch.
GET /download
query path or paths (JSON array)
Multiple paths, or a single directory, are always zipped on the fly.
GET /du
query path?
Recursive disk-usage total (no depth/size cap — can be slow on very large trees).

entries.title: PHP-FPM
entries.text:
/api/php-fpm
Mixed auth: pool/version/module mutation routes are requireAdmin; several read-only routes are not (and inconsistently so — see the note at the end).
Pool management
Method & PathAuthDescription
GET /status
session
Overall PHP-FPM service status.
GET /pools
session
Lists all configured pools.
GET /pools/:poolName
session
Single pool.
POST /pools
admin
Body: poolName, user (required) + many optional tuning fields (pmStyle, maxChildren, memoryLimit, openBasedir, etc).
PUT /pools/:poolName
admin
Same shape as create.
DELETE /pools/:poolName
admin
Selectable versions (domain-creation dropdown)
Method & PathAuthDescription
GET /versions
session
The effective selectable list — configured list if set, else auto-detected installed versions.
POST /versions
admin
Body: version (x.y). Adds to the selectable list — does not install it (see below for that).
DELETE /versions/:version
admin
400 if it would leave zero versions selectable.
Version install/remove (system package level)
Method & PathDescription
GET /php-versions/status
Per-version install state/source (system, Remi, ondrej PPA) for the 6 known versions (7.4–8.4).
POST /php-versions/install-remi
Installs the Remi (EL) or ondrej PPA (Debian) multi-version repo.
POST /php-versions/:version/install
Installs an actual PHP version's packages, enables its FPM service, auto-adds it to the selectable list.
DELETE /php-versions/:version
400 if it's the protected system PHP.
Module (extension) management
Method & PathDescription
GET /modules/:version
Loaded modules + installed packages for that version.
GET /modules/:version/search
Query q. Searches available packages.
POST /modules/:version
Body: module?, packageName? (at least one).
DELETE /modules/:version/:module
All routes in this last block require admin, including the read-only ones — inconsistent with GET /pools//versions above, which don't.

entries.title: Clients
entries.text:
/api/clients
Read this before using this module
PUT /:username, POST /:username/suspend, /unsuspend, and /change-password have no admin check and no ownership check. Any authenticated user can act on any other username. Do not expose these four routes without your own authorization layer in front of them.
Method & PathAuth (as shipped)Description
GET /
session
Query: loginType?, parent?, status?. Password stripped from results.
GET /:username
session
Single client, password stripped.
POST /
admin
Body: username, password, email, loginType, parent?, plus arbitrary options.
PUT /:username
none
Arbitrary body fields merged onto the client (except nname/password, which are stripped from the payload). If resourcePlanName is in the body, that plan's limits override anything else supplied in the same request.
GET /:username/delete-summary
admin
Pre-delete impact report for a confirmation dialog.
DELETE /:username
admin
Full teardown — client and every associated resource.
POST /:username/suspend
none
POST /:username/unsuspend
none
POST /:username/change-password
none
Body: newPassword. No current-password check either.
GET /:username/subclients
session
Reseller's sub-accounts (parent === username).

entries.title: Resource Plans
entries.text:
/api/resource-plans
No requireAdmin here either — full CRUD is reachable by any authenticated user. This is the dedicated surface for the ResourcePlan entity, with named-field defaults and duplicate-name protection (contrast with the cruder duplicate at /api/system/resource-plans, described above).
Method & PathBodyDescription
GET /
—
Lists plans; returns an empty list gracefully if the table doesn't exist yet.
GET /:name
—
POST /
name (required), description?, domainLimit? (default 5), diskLimit? (default 1000), bandwidthLimit? (default 5000), mailAccountLimit? (default 10), ftpAccountLimit? (default 5), databaseLimit? (default 5)
409 on duplicate name. Note: ftpAccountLimit in the request maps to the ftpLimit column internally.
PUT /:name
any subset of the fields above
Partial update — only fields present in the body are changed.
DELETE /:name
—
Deleting a plan does not appear to cascade-clean any client rows still referencing it by name.

entries.title: Client Self-Service
entries.text:
/api/client
The API a domain-owner/reseller's own dashboard calls — everything here scopes to resources the logged-in client owns. Every route implements its own privilege-flag check (see Roles & Permissions) plus a manual ownership check comparing the resource's clientName/parent to the caller — admins bypass the ownership check but not the privilege-flag check.
Dashboard
GET /dashboard — resource counts plus live-computed disk usage (du -sb over the client's home + mail directories) and bandwidth (parsed from Apache access logs). Response: { client, privileges, usage: {disk, bandwidth, domains, subdomains, mailAccounts, ftpAccounts, databases}, counts }.
Domains & subdomains
Method & PathPrivilegeDescription
GET /domains
domain_flag
Own domains only.
POST /domains
domain_add_flag
Body: domainName (required) + options. Enforces the account's domain-count limit.
DELETE /domains/:domainName
domain_delete_flag
Ownership verified.
GET /domains/:domainName/stats-report
—
Streams the raw stats HTML; 404 page if not generated yet.
GET / PUT /domains/:domainName/vhost
domain_flag
Manual vhost editor — same "no syntax validation before reload" caveat as the admin version.
GET / PUT /domains/:domainName/vhost-ssl
domain_flag
Raw SSL vhost editor — lets a client hand-edit SSL config directly, a meaningful trust boundary if you expose this to end customers.
GET / PUT /domains/:domainName/vhost-webmail
domain_flag
Apache-only, hardcoded path (no multi-webserver support here).
GET /subdomains
domain_flag
POST /subdomains
domain_add_flag
Body: subdomainName, parentDomain (required) + options. Verifies parent-domain ownership.
Mail
Method & PathPrivilegeDescription
GET /mail/domains
mail_flag
GET /mail/accounts
mail_flag
Password stripped.
POST /mail/accounts
mail_add_flag
Body: email (or local+domainName), password (required), quota?. Enforces mailbox-count limit. vpopmail sync failures are logged, not fatal.
PUT /mail/accounts/:email/password
mail_password_flag
DELETE /mail/accounts/:email
mail_delete_flag
GET /mail/forwards
mail_flag
POST /mail/forwards
mail_add_flag
Body: source, destination (required). No domain-ownership check here, unlike most other mail routes in this module.
DELETE /mail/forwards/:name
mail_delete_flag
DNS
Method & PathPrivilegeDescription
GET /dns/zones
dns_flag
GET /dns/zones/:domainName/records
dns_flag
POST /dns/zones/:domainName/records
dns_add_flag
Body: hostname, type, content (required), ttl?, priority?. Writes directly via the record repo, without the zone-resync step the PUT below performs.
PUT /dns/zones/:domainName/records/:recordId
dns_flag
Delegates to the same service method the admin DNS module uses — properly resyncs.
DELETE /dns/zones/:domainName/records/:recordId
dns_delete_flag
Plain repo remove — no explicit resync call, inconsistent with PUT above.
PUT /dns/zones/:domainName/update-ip
dns_flag
Body: newIp (required). Bulk A-record update.
FTP
Method & PathPrivilegeDescription
GET /ftp
ftp_flag
POST /ftp
ftp_add_flag
Enforces the FTP-account limit.
PUT /ftp/:username/password
ftp_password_flag
Only updates the DB row — no call into the FTP driver to actually change the live password. Likely incomplete.
DELETE /ftp/:username
ftp_delete_flag
Same gap — no live system removal.
Databases
Method & PathPrivilegeDescription
GET /databases
database_flag
Returns both databases and DB users.
POST /databases
database_add_flag
Body: dbName (required), dbUserName?, dbPassword?. Also always grants the client's existing main DB user access to the new database (so a single phpMyAdmin-SSO identity can see everything they own).
DELETE /databases/:dbName
database_delete_flag
Uses a bare mysql -u root call for the drop — may fail silently depending on local MySQL auth config.
PUT /databases/:dbName/password
database_password_flag
Same bare-mysql caveat.
POST /db-users
database_add_flag
Body: dbUserName, password (required).
DELETE /db-users/:userName
database_delete_flag
PUT /db-users/:userName/password
database_password_flag
PUT /db-users/:userName/privileges
database_add_flag
Body: dbName (required), privileges?, revoke?.
SSL / Let's Encrypt
Method & PathPrivilegeDescription
GET /ssl
ssl_flag
Also picks up admin-issued certs matched by domain name where clientName was left blank, backfilling ownership as a side effect.
POST /ssl/letsencrypt
ssl_add_flag
Body: domainName (required), email?. Full self-service Let's Encrypt issuance scoped to an owned domain.
PHP version
Method & PathDescription
GET /php-versions
Read-only, informational, no privilege gate.
PUT /domains/:domainName/php-version
domain_flag + ownership. Body: phpVersion (required). Rejects a version outside the admin-configured allowlist.
Backup & restore (client self-service)
Components: files, settings, emails, ssl, databases, ftp, dns, apache, webmail (note: ftp is listed but not actually implemented as its own block — FTP users are folded into the settings component). All require backup_flag and are async/task-tracked.
Method & PathDescription
GET /backups
Lists the client's own archives.
GET /backups/task/:taskId
Poll an in-progress backup/restore.
POST /backups/create
Body: components? (array, default all). Includes plaintext mail/DB/FTP passwords in the exported JSON — only SSL private keys are stripped from the export.
DELETE /backups/:filename
GET /backups/:filename/download
Streams the file; works from a plain window.open() since it uses the normal session/JWT.
POST /backups/:filename/restore
Body: skipExisting?. Rejects non-client-format manifests (400) but does not verify the manifest's own recorded username matches the caller — restoring another client's exported archive is possible if you can get the file into your own backup directory. Restored SSL certs are force-reassigned to the calling client regardless of the manifest's data, mitigating that specific case.
Account settings & two-factor authentication
Method & PathDescription
GET /account
Profile fields.
PUT /account
Body: any of email, realname, phone, address, city, state, zip, country, language, skin.
PUT /account/password
Body: currentPassword, newPassword (required).
POST /account/2fa/setup
Generates a TOTP secret + QR code. Not persisted until /confirm succeeds.
POST /account/2fa/confirm
Body: secret, code (required). Verifies the first live code, enables 2FA, returns one-time backup codes.
POST /account/2fa/disable
Body: password (required).
Example: enroll in two-factor auth
curl -X POST https://<your-server>:7777/api/client/account/2fa/setup \
-H "Authorization: Bearer <TOKEN>"
# { "success": true, "secret": "...", "qrCodeUrl": "..." }
curl -X POST https://<your-server>:7777/api/client/account/2fa/confirm \
-H "Authorization: Bearer <TOKEN>" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
-d '{"secret":"…","code":"123456"}'
# { "success": true, "backupCodes": ["…", "…", …] }
Webmail access
GET /webmail-url
Per-domain webmail URLs the client owns.
POST /domains/:domainName/webmail-client
Body: clientType (roundcube|rainloop, required). Ownership re-verified without the usual admin bypass.
AI Spam Filter — client-scoped whitelist/blacklist/stats
These duplicate the file-rewrite logic in the admin Spam Filter module inline rather than sharing a helper — keep both in sync if you ever patch one.
GET / POST / DELETE /spam-whitelist(/:id)
Global-scope entries are hidden from clients; only domain/user-scope entries they own.
GET / POST / DELETE /spam-blacklist(/:id)
Mirrors the whitelist routes exactly.
GET /spam-stats
Spam/ham counts and token usage for domains that have the AI filter enabled.

entries.title: Webmail
entries.text:
/api/webmail
requireHostingAccess only — no admin gate on any individual route, even though these control the panel's global webmail client install/config. Treat this router as admin-only in your own integration.
Method & PathDescription
GET /status
Installed clients/versions + the active config (DB → filesystem detection → none).
GET /config
Active configuration; auto-detects from the filesystem if no DB row exists yet (without persisting anything).
PUT /config
Body: a large whitelist of Roundcube/RainLoop-specific fields (IMAP/SMTP host/port, language, theme, plugin toggles, etc). Pushes select fields live into the installed client's own config, not just the DB.
POST /install/roundcube
POST /install/rainloop
POST /uninstall/:clientType
clientType: roundcube|rainloop.
POST /switch
Body: clientType (required). Switches the server-wide active webmail client.
POST /domain/:domainName/enable
Body: clientType? (auto-detected if omitted). Creates the domain's webmail vhost and RainLoop domain config.
POST /domain/:domainName/disable
GET /domains
All domains with webmail currently enabled.
POST /rebuild
Regenerates every enabled domain's webmail vhost plus the global one — the "fix script" equivalent for webmail.

entries.title: phpMyAdmin SSO
entries.text:
/api/phpmyadmin
requireHostingAccess; install/uninstall/client-access-toggle routes additionally require admin. Issues short-lived, single-use SSO tokens so a client can open phpMyAdmin without re-entering MySQL credentials.
Method & PathAuthDescription
GET /status
session
Install state, version, and per-client access toggles.
POST /install
admin
DELETE /uninstall
admin
PUT /clients/:clientName
admin
Body: enabled (required). Per-client access toggle.
PUT /clients-bulk
admin
Body: clients: [{clientName, enabled}].
POST /sso
session
Body: dbName? (opens directly to that database if given). Admins get root credentials; clients get (or auto-create) their own DB user. Verifies the resolved credentials actually work before issuing a token. Returns {token, signonUrl, mysqlUser, isAdmin} — the token is single-use with a 60-second TTL, consumed by a separate PHP signon script, not by the SPA directly.
GET /sso-validate
session
Called by the signon script to redeem the one-time token.
GET /client-access
session
{installed, hasAccess, isAdmin, url} — used to decide whether to show a phpMyAdmin button at all.

entries.title: Email Stats
entries.text:
/api/email-stats
requireHostingAccess; most routes additionally require admin. Two routes (POST /record, GET /rate-check) don't, and are really meant to be called by the internal qmail-queue wrapper script rather than the SPA — they still require a valid session/JWT like everything else under /api.
Method & PathDescription
GET /
Today's summary across all domains.
GET /daily
Query: domain?, start?, end?. Each row annotated with whether the domain is hosted here and/or blacklisted.
GET /monthly
Query: domain?, year?, month?.
POST /record
Body: domain (required), clientName?. Records one outbound send — called once per message by the mail pipeline.
GET /rate-check
Query: domain (required). Used by the mail pipeline to decide whether to throttle a send.
POST /:domain/scan
Fire-and-forget manual ClamAV scan of a domain's mail.
GET /:domain/scan-status
PUT /:domain/outbound-scan
Body: enabled (required).
POST /rebuild-rate-limits
Rewrites the mail wrapper's rate-limit config from current data.
GET /:domain/config
Effective rate limit, current throttle status, this-hour send count, and (if the client has a resource plan) its auto-scan threshold.
PUT /:domain/rate-limit
Body: emailRateLimit (required, ≥0).
GET /sender-blacklist
POST /sender-blacklist
Body: domain (required), reason?. This is a sender-side blacklist (blocks mail claiming to be from these domains) — distinct from the AI Spam Filter's recipient-facing lists.
DELETE /sender-blacklist/:domain

entries.title: AI Spam Filter
entries.text:
/api/spam-filter
Gated only by requireLicenseFeature('ai-spam-filter') — no role check anywhere in this file. Any authenticated user, once the Pro add-on is licensed, can read/modify global provider config (including masked-but-updatable API keys), install/uninstall the filter, and manage any domain's or account's filtering settings, whitelist, or blacklist. The client-scoped equivalents in Client Self-Service do enforce ownership — this admin surface does not enforce role at all.
Configuration & install
Method & PathDescription
GET /config
Provider API keys returned masked (••••••••) if set.
PUT /config
Body: provider/model/threshold/timeout settings + the 4 provider API keys (Ollama, OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini) — a submitted key is only applied if it doesn't start with •, so the masked GET response round-trips safely.
GET /status
Install state + PHP availability.
POST /install
Prerequisite checks (vpopmail, vdelivermail, PHP, deploy bundle) before proceeding.
POST /test-provider
Runs a live connectivity test against the configured AI provider.
Domain & account enablement
Method & PathDescription
GET /domains
Every mail-hosted domain with its filter-enabled state + confidence threshold.
PUT /domains/:domain/enable
Body: confidenceThreshold?. Pipes all mail for the domain through the filter; pre-creates quarantine folders for every existing mailbox.
PUT /domains/:domain/disable
Restores plain delivery.
GET /accounts
Query: domain?. Per-mailbox filter mode (on/off/inherit) and effective resolved state.
PUT /accounts/:address/filter-mode
Body: filterMode (on|off|inherit, required). Per-mailbox override of the domain default.
Statistics & token usage
Method & PathDescription
GET /stats
Query: period? (days, default 30). Spam/ham breakdown by domain, account, and classification type.
GET /stats/recent
Query: limit? (default 100). Most-recent-first raw entries.
GET /token-usage
Aggregated by provider, model, domain, and month.
POST /token-usage/reset
Backs up the current usage log before truncating it.
Whitelist / blacklist (global admin view)
Method & PathDescription
GET / POST / DELETE /whitelist(/:id)
Body (POST): scope (global|domain|user), scopeTarget, entryType (email|domain), entryValue. 409 on duplicate.
GET / POST / DELETE /blacklist(/:id)
Same shape, opposite effect.
A public, unauthenticated endpoint, GET /wl-approve (mounted outside /api entirely), backs the one-click "whitelist this sender" links emailed to end users when their mail is quarantined — it validates an HMAC-signed, 7-day-expiring token rather than requiring a login.

entries.title: AI Agent
entries.text:
/api/aiagent
requireLicenseFeature('ai-agent') requireAdmin on every route — the only AI add-on module that's fully role-gated. Many routes additionally require the agent to be toggled on (503 otherwise). This module is a thin proxy in front of a separate Node service ("AI Agent Assistant") running on its own system user and port, so most calls here forward to that service's own local HTTP API rather than doing the work directly.
Enable / service control
Method & PathDescription
GET / POST /enabled
Global on/off toggle for the whole feature.
GET /service
Install state, systemd status, and a live health-check probe.
POST /service/:action
action: start|stop|restart.
GET /status
The agent's own status + configured sub-agents.
GET /active-tasks
Settings, logs, token usage
Method & PathDescription
GET / PUT /settings
A whitelisted subset of the agent's own .env — provider/model choice, Telegram/Discord/WhatsApp toggles, Redis/API endpoints, log level.
GET /logs
Query: lines? (default 200, capped 500). Falls back to journalctl if no log files are found.
GET /token-usage
The agent's own usage tracking (separate from the Spam Filter's).
POST /token-usage/reset
Automations: NL scripts, playbooks, scheduled tasks
Method & PathDescription
GET / POST /nlscripts
Named, saved multi-step "natural language" playbooks. POST body: name, steps[] (required), description?.
PUT /nlscripts/:name
Shallow merge onto the existing record — no shape validation on update.
DELETE /nlscripts/:name
GET /playbooks
Read-only summaries (with step bodies stripped) of behaviors the agent has learned. No create/edit route — these are written by the agent itself.
GET /playbooks/:id
Full playbook.
DELETE /playbooks/:id
GET /scheduled-tasks
PUT /scheduled-tasks/:id
Same unrestricted merge as NL scripts. No create route — tasks are created by the agent's own scheduler.
DELETE /scheduled-tasks/:id
Email accounts & credentials vault
Method & PathDescription
GET /email-accounts
Secrets stripped from the response.
POST /email-accounts
Body: email (required) + arbitrary other fields — stored as-is, including any secret fields you pass, since only the GET strips them.
DELETE /email-accounts/:email
GET /credentials
Lists stored secret names only — values are never returned.
POST /credentials
Body: key, value (required). key restricted to a safe character set.
DELETE /credentials/:key
Private knowledge base
Admin-authored operational notes injected into the agent's context — never exposed to clients. Seeded with 15 built-in articles covering the panel's own architecture on first run.
GET /private-kb
Excerpted list.
GET /private-kb/:nname
Full article.
POST /private-kb
Body: nname, title, category, content (required). Acts as create-or-update (unusual for POST, but this is the documented behavior).
PUT /private-kb/:nname
DELETE /private-kb/:nname
Chat (streaming)
Method & PathDescription
GET /chat/stream/:sessionId
Server-Sent Events proxy to the agent's own webchat stream.
POST /chat/message
Body: sessionId, text. The first message of a new session gets the private KB context automatically prepended.
POST /chat/approve
Approves a pending shell command the agent asked to run.
POST /chat/cancel/:sessionId
DELETE /chat/history/:sessionId
Install & maintenance
Method & PathDescription
GET /install/status
Whether an install is currently in progress.
POST /install/fix-permissions
POST /install/fix-memory-limit
Raises the systemd unit's memory cap if child processes were getting OOM-killed.
POST /install
Async, task-tracked full install: dedicated system user, Redis, downloads the agent source, builds it, installs a narrowly-scoped sudoers file, sets up and starts the systemd unit.

entries.title: Migration
entries.text:
/api/migration
requireLicenseFeature('migration') on the entire router (402 if not Pro-licensed). Drives account migrations by connecting outward from this server to a source (cPanel/WHM, another SysAdminHCP, or a legacy KloxoNG box) and pulling accounts in. All migration/resync actions are async — kicked off fire-and-forget and tracked via Task Tracker.
API key management
Mints the keys that other servers use to call this server's Migration Export API — not for calling this router itself.
Method & PathAuthDescription
POST /api-keys
admin
Body: label?, scopeClientName? (restrict to one client), expiresInDays?. Returns the raw <id>.<secret> exactly once.
GET /api-keys
admin
Lists keys, secret/hash excluded.
DELETE /api-keys/:id
admin
Soft-revokes (doesn't delete the row).
cPanel / WHM migration
Method & PathDescription
POST /cpanel/test
Body: host, apiToken (required), port? (default 2087), username? (default root), rejectUnauthorized?.
POST /cpanel/accounts
Lists WHM accounts.
POST /cpanel/accounts/:username/preview
Shows what would be imported without changing anything.
POST /cpanel/accounts/:username/migrate
Body adds sshPassword, sshPort? (for pulling files directly) + per-resource toggles (migrateDns/Email/Databases/Files/Ssl/Ftp, default true) and skipExisting?. Returns {success, message, taskId} immediately.
SysAdminHCP → SysAdminHCP migration
Method & PathDescription
POST /sysadminhcp/test
Body: host, apiKey (required — the source's minted Migration API key), port? (default 7777), ssl? (default true), sshUser/sshPassword/sshPort?.
POST /sysadminhcp/clients
Lists clients the key is scoped to see on the remote.
POST /sysadminhcp/clients/:name/preview
POST /sysadminhcp/clients/:name/migrate
Adds per-resource toggles + postMigrationAction? (none|suspend|delete the source account after success).
POST /sysadminhcp/clients/:name/resync
Requires sshPassword explicitly (400 otherwise) — re-pulls an already-migrated client's changed data.
KloxoNG migration
Pure-SSH (root password), no HTTP API on the source side.
Method & PathDescription
POST /kloxong/test
Body: host, rootPassword (required), sshPort?.
POST /kloxong/clients
POST /kloxong/clients/:name/preview
POST /kloxong/clients/:name/migrate
Same per-resource toggle shape as the others.
POST /kloxong/clients/:name/resync
None of the /cpanel/*, /sysadminhcp/*, or /kloxong/* routes require admin explicitly — only the router-level Pro license gate applies, so any logged-in user with the feature enabled can drive a migration. Every migration/resync call swallows its eventual failure into the task record, not the initial HTTP response — a 200 confirms the job started, never that it finished successfully.

entries.title: Remote Servers
entries.text:
/api/remote-servers
requireAdmin + requireLicenseFeature('migration') on every route. A saved address-book of other SysAdminHCP instances, used both as migration connection presets and as DNS Cluster peer registrations (dnsClusterEnabled/nsRole).
Method & PathDescription
GET /
Lists servers with apiKey/sshPassword masked.
GET /:id
Returns the real, unmasked credentials — the only route in this module that does. Handle accordingly.
POST /
Body: host, apiKey (required) + optional label/port/ssl/ssh fields/dnsClusterEnabled/nsRole. Upserts by matching host+port. Submitting "***" for sshPassword leaves the stored value untouched (so the UI can round-trip the masked value safely).
PUT /:id
Partial update — notably host/port/apiKey/ssl are not editable via this route; re-POST or delete+recreate to change those.
DELETE /:id
POST /test
Body: host, apiKey (required). Actually round-trips to the remote's export API; updates the matching registry row's connection status as a side effect if one exists.

entries.title: License
entries.text:
/api/license
requireAdmin on the entire router. Manages this panel's own license state and the Billing API keys that SysAdminBillCP uses to call back into Billing API.
Method & PathDescription
GET /
Current license status.
GET /hosting-access
Whether the Hosting menu should be gated (grace period elapsed with no active license).
POST /
Body: licenseKey, billingServerUrl (required). Saves configuration without validating/activating it — call /validate next.
POST /validate
Round-trips to the billing server to re-check validity, then (if active) auto-registers this panel's IP with it.
GET /server-ip
This server's detected public IP (what gets registered with the billing server).
POST /local-activate
Body: features? (default ['ai-agent','ai-spam-filter','migration']), licensedTo?, expiresAt?, registeredIp?, licenseKey?. Self-activates a license with no external verification — an escape hatch for standalone use without a SysAdminBillCP deployment.
GET /billing-keys
Lists Billing API keys (hash stripped).
POST /billing-keys
Body: label (required), permissions? (read|write|admin, default read), expiresAt?. Returns the raw secret exactly once.
PUT /billing-keys/:id/status
Toggles on/off. The auto-managed BillCP Auto-Registration key is protected from this (403).
DELETE /billing-keys/:id
Same protection for the auto-registration key.
